identity_policy: Names require a Japanese message and runtime actor binding; a descriptor, placement row or shared image alone does not establish a character identity.
evidence: Banks are the frame directories of the descriptor table at 0x08300000 that no named character document owns, keyed by directory address; a bank lists the descriptors that share its directory. Directories lie back to back from 0x08307478 and frame streams from 0x08319126, both in directory order, each bank's streams in address order; the regions list them in that order. Codec 3 streams are arena LZ over zero-skip bytes, each bank the dictionary of its later streams. An absent frame stores no zero-skip bytes: its stream is a bare raw split, whose reader borrows the next stream's zero as its terminator. Codec 0 frames are raw zero-skip bytes. Codec 1 frames are tagged LZ over indexed bytes, general or palette, whichever is smaller, palette on ties. runtime_bindings, where present, are the actor placement rows (u16 descriptor, 0xffff, u32 behaviour, x, y, z and flags as 16.16 words, closed by a 0x0000ffff row) in overlays 0x64d, 0x64e, 0x650, 0x651 and 0x652 that name a bank's descriptor; banks without the field have not been searched. Archives are battle sprite resources of the range 0x203-0x26b, keyed by resource: general LZ over u32 frame offsets closed by 0, then the zero-skip frames in frame_order; an offset at the end of the stream names a frame the archive does not store, and a repeated offset draws one stored frame in several cells. The 105 codec 2 descriptors have null directories and runtime-loaded frames; the loader that pairs them with the 105 resources of that range has not been read.
